name: 41 dataset camera moves
coordinate_system: camera-local, Blender coordinates used verbatim: location [right, up, back] metres (-Z is forward), rotation [rx, ry, rz] degrees about the camera's own axes, applied to the camera's pose on the sequence's first frame; keys are absolute frames at 24 fps over 6 s
amplitude_note: Nominal amplitudes.  Translation may be scaled down to fit the scene (the region box); rotation and focal are never scaled.
